repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

2026-11-17T08:35Z **Ruled.** Steve chose an option on this project's decision card for #34348 at 2026-11-17T08:26:17Z. Option text verbatim: 「全部按推荐」 — 「七张都按上面写的推荐回队开工,#33952 按包取翻译,#34427 只写文档后关卡。」. It answers the seat analysis on this card (this card is one of the seven, together with #34452). Freshness: no comment on this card is newer than that analysis, and the body was not edited after it.

Ruled: option (b)
- One rule for both cards: the environment's own item always answers first, whatever number of packages hold the same name and whether they are enabled, and reads and writes give the same answer.

**State: `pm:blocked` until #34347 merges.**

Blocked-by: #34347

When it merges, re-measure every cell on `main` before any code; a cell that moved is reported here, not built over.

director#1 · hotlong · session_b003f8166db74ab6b50632f4b346fe76

2026-11-17T19:03Z **Unblocked: the blocker has landed.**

objectstack#34347 merged at 2026-11-17T12:52Z as `89d5a41ff975` on `main` (read from the PR, verified against `origin/main`).

The ruled rule stands: the environment's own item answers first, and reads and writes agree. The lane's first step is the one the card names: re-measure every cell on `main` at or after `89d5a41f` before any code; a cell that moved is reported here, not built over.

`pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` (applied just before this comment). The grade is unchanged (p2).

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in area:package · domain:server · Bug · priority:p2 · `needs-user-decision` · size S; rationale: a contract review escalated this decision. A package-unbound stored row beside a name that only disabled packages hold, or that two enabled packages hold, is refused by the bare read (404 / 409) yet edited by the bare save (200). It waits for the maintainer's ruling, not for a developer, so it moves from `pm:queue` to `needs-user-decision` and no seat picks it before the ruling.

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in area:package · domain:server · Bug · priority:p2 · `pm:queue` · size M; rationale: **correction of triage's 08:44Z move.** This card was ruled on 2026-11-17 (option (b), record of 08:35Z: the environment's own item always answers first, whatever number of packages hold the name and whether they are enabled, and reads and writes agree). It was unblocked to `pm:queue` at 19:04Z that day. Triage misread it as unruled and moved it to `needs-user-decision`. It goes back to `pm:queue`; the ruling stands.

Re-measured read-only today on `main` (`df0894a664`, a throwaway copy of `meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, not committed; dashboard type, both transports, both registration orders): both cells are exactly as the card says. Cell 1 is bare read 404 / bare save 200, still unreadable afterwards. Cell 2 is bare read 409 / bare save 200. Neither `?package=` nor the `_env` address reaches the row. PR #34355 (#33210) did not move cell 2's read; it pinned the refusal.

One scope question is put to the maintainer in the triage session: executing (b) reverses PR #34355's refusal (ADR-0087 entry `two-row-holders-bare-read-refused`), which merged 4.5 hours before the ruling and is not named by it. A reader waits for that answer before building the cell-2 read side.

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

## Maintainer principle and split · 2026-11-26T09:15Z

In the triage session, verbatim: 「我觉得停用就该全部消失」, then 「同意」 to triage's split, after a second read-only analysis.

- **Ruling (b) narrowed.** The 2026-11-17 clause "and whether they are enabled" is withdrawn for the disabled-only case. A package-unbound row at a name an installed package holds is that package's customization (the #33401 seat ruling, PR #33995). While every holder is disabled it is hidden at every door, read **and write**, and re-enable serves it untouched.
- **Correction of triage's comment of today (~09:03Z):**
  - its scope line "the bare read serves the environment's own row beside a name only disabled packages hold (cell 1)" is withdrawn;
  - its "known side effect, accepted with the ruling" is withdrawn too: the maintainer did not accept it, and the principle rejects it.
- **Split:** cell 1 moves to **#37499** (p1, child of #36229): every write door refuses while all holders are disabled, with the remedy "enable the package first". The uninstall question goes to **#37500** (p3, measure first).
- **This card keeps cell 2 only.** A package-unbound row beside two or more **enabled** holders is served by the bare read (200) and edited by the bare save, so reads and writes agree. PR #34355's bare-read refusal is reversed for this case (「#34355 一并改回」). The PR must leave the disabled-only arm alone; a disabled holder counts for nothing (the mixed case of #34452).

State stays `pm:queue` (p2 · area:package).
